Ruth is an ancestor of Jack (Ruth → Rebecca → Noah → Henry → Diane → Martha → Amanda → Kimberly → Elizabeth → Sandra → Kenneth → Joyce → Marilyn → Robert → Jeremy → Katherine → Carl → Kelly → Joan → Helen → Adam → Matthew → Jack).

Gerald is also an ancestor of Jack (Gerald → Gary → Jonathan → Carol → Arthur → Steven → Grace → Karen → Andrew → Bradley → Ralph → Joe → Ann → George → Sara → Mason → Catherine → Theresa → Evelyn → Debra → Janet → Julie → Virginia → Harold → Samuel → Frank → Susan → Edward → Frances → Brian → Alan → Jordan → Victoria → Maria → Thomas → Abigail → Christopher → Wayne → Jacqueline → Mark → Justin → Jack).

So Ruth and Gerald share a common descendant.
